checks.unsigned_refusal_reason: verification/scenarios/corpus.json names no approver; scenario intent is the Operator's, not a worker's

checks.scenario_parity_selftest: PASS, local loopback fixtures; no v9 application execution

comparison_contract.location: Literal value after mapping only the declared source origin to the destination origin; preserve path, context path, escaping, query, fragment and generated id. No id normalization.
comparison_contract.cors_lists: Allow-Methods, Allow-Headers and Expose-Headers compare as case-insensitive token sets under the existing harness contract.
comparison_contract.errors_and_content_type: Literal values, including absent versus present; errors is not moved to a body or normalized as JSON by this contract.
comparison_contract.content_type_consequence: A charset-only difference is a FAIL of this strict representation contract. RFC 8259 section 11 does not define a charset parameter for application/json; the difference alone does not prove a client regression. No automatic waiver.
comparison_contract.effects: Declared before/after GET status and canonical body digests; these probes do not inherit the primary-response extra header assertions.
comparison_contract.source_of_expected_values: Fresh source captures only. Qualification criteria describe the intended scenario, not fabricated response oracles.

qualification.authority: Operator reviews and records qualification before captures can count as coverage; these criteria are not an implemented automatic promotion gate.
required_for_every_capture: Bind source digest, bundle digest, final signed corpus digest and request/body digests to this packet; archive the prior idle receipt.
Record the first response with redirects_followed false and asserted_headers_extra exactly [content-type, errors].
The response headers map contains all nine primary-response header keys, including explicit null for headers actually absent. Invalid-create errors must be present and nonempty.

Retain complete before/after owner response bodies, or equivalent semantic qualification results tied to the same full-body digests and capture execution. A 200-character sample cannot establish owner presence or absence.
Verify reset and identity allocation state before destination comparison. Matching list rows alone does not prove matching next generated ids.

sc:update-owner-1-city: PUT returns 204; both effect probes return 200.
The owner with id 1 has city Monona in the owner read-back and full owners list.
sc:create-owner-location: POST returns 201 with an absolute Location on the recorded source origin under the source context path.
Complete GET /api/owners responses return 200 before and after; the request owner is absent before and exactly one matching owner is added afterward.
The generated id agrees across Location, the response owner and the owner added to the list.
Origin is permitted and Access-Control-Expose-Headers includes errors and content-type; record all permission headers, including legitimate absences.
sc:cors-actual-owners: GET returns 200 from the reset seeded state.
Origin is permitted and Access-Control-Expose-Headers includes errors and content-type; record all permission headers, including legitimate absences.
sc:cors-preflight-owners: Anonymous OPTIONS returns a successful 2xx response without following redirects.
The effective permission headers allow the paired POST from the same Origin with Content-Type; no credentials or database effects are sent.
Capture all CORS header keys. Expose-Headers need not be present on the preflight; exposure qualification belongs to actual responses.
sc:create-owner-invalid: POST returns 400; a nonempty errors header parses as a JSON array containing fieldName telephone, fieldValue not-a-number and a nonempty errorMessage.
The source supplies the error wording; do not invent a message, locale or constraint name as the expected oracle.
Complete GET /api/owners responses return 200 before and after, their canonical body digests are equal, and the rejected owner is absent from both lists.
The 400 response also permits the request Origin and exposes errors and content-type, so cross-origin callers can read the validation error.

qualification.coverage_boundary: Five scenarios reference three Owner entry points. Structural CORS policy coverage has no gaps; runtime qualification and full 34-entry-point/six-Location coverage are not established.

capture_prerequisites: After signature, pause dispatch at a quiescent card boundary and keep it paused through capture qualification.

Install and record a coherent capture gate script set from the intended golden f4afa010; verify reviewed script hashes and installed-code tests. Preserve authorization pins, home/board/logs, config and loop state.
Provide complete read-back evidence or digest-bound semantic qualification during the source execution; f4afa010 capture receipts alone retain only 200-character body samples.
Install the signed corpus and all three bodies at the declared destination paths; verify their final manifest digests before capture.
implementation_limits: An older source header map lacking errors/content-type can still compare without detecting those missing assertions. The focused helper probe reproduces this; fresh complete header evidence is mandatory for this packet.
An unreadable source exposed-header model only warns during capture. Qualification must refuse missing model binding or missing expected extra-header keys.
CAPTURED records an HTTP observation, including an unexpected status; it does not establish the scenario purpose or authorize coverage.
Owner lists are retained only as full-body digests plus 200-character samples by the reviewed producer. Complete list evidence or digest-bound semantic observations remain a capture prerequisite.

signing.scope: The Operator signs the final corpus document and this review manifest together; the manifest binds every referenced body byte digest, request digest, source binding and comparison/qualification contract.
signing.procedure: Review the full packet, fill the real approved_by identity in the corpus and manifest, recompute the corpus file and canonical digests plus every request/body digest, and sign that final pair. Preserve this unsigned review as provenance.
signing.body_content_binding: body_manifest SHA-256 plus request_sha256; body paths alone do not bind bytes.
